records.audit_problem: The V5 artifact ownership matrix disagreed with worker/stage contracts and omitted ownership rows for several worker outputs.
records.audit_required_change: Define one canonical ownership precedence, derive a complete ownership graph from V6 contracts, use one primary writer per artifact, remove W12/S9 and W11/S16 conflicts, and add ownership QA.
records.V2_change: V6 defines canonical worker/stage contracts first, derives a 40-artifact single-writer graph, removes conflicting W12 and W11 outputs, adds missing output rows, and validates every source against the canonical owner.
records.residual_risk: Future execution must retain the single-writer rule when new artifacts are introduced.

records.audit_problem: HG-11 routed worker-output failure generically to S16 and did not identify the originating worker or repair stage.
records.audit_required_change: Create per-worker failure routes with failure class, failed artifact, return worker/stage, reconciliation stage, owner, revision, re-entry gate, retry policy and human-review condition; cross-check routes against hard gates.
records.V2_change: V6 adds a route matrix covering W01-W12 and all required failure classes, failure_routes and re-entry fields to every worker, and a worker-to-hard-gate QA matrix. S16 is retained only for genuine package-level failures.
records.residual_risk: A future execution must use worker-specific routes for content failures and the package route only for package defects.
